55606-the-mandarin-s-fan.title: The Mandarin S Fan
55606-the-mandarin-s-fan.creator: Unknown
55606-the-mandarin-s-fan.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Hume has given us since he wrote 'The Mystery of a Hansom Cab.' The plot is very ingenious. Devoid of suspicion of padding, brightly and smoothly written, Mr. Fergus Hume's latest tale contains not a single dull chapter."--_World_.

arxiv-2104-01856.title: Direction-Based Jamming Detection and Suppression in mmWave Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2104-01856.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the problem of physical layer security in the uplink of millimeter-wave massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks and propose a jamming detection and suppression method. The proposed method is based on directional information of the received signals at the base station antenna array.

arxiv-2111-03517.title: Snapshot Ptychography on Array Cameras
arxiv-2111-03517.creator: Chengyu Wang, Minghao Hu, Yuzuru Takashima, Timothy J. Schulz, David J. Brady
arxiv-2111-03517.description: Abstract We use convolutional neural networks to recover images optically down-sampled by 6.7 × 6.7\times using coherent aperture synthesis over a 16 camera array. Where conventional ptychography relies on scanning and oversampling, here we apply decompressive neural estimation to recover full resolution image from a single snapshot, although as shown in simulation multiple snapshots can be used to improve SNR.

arxiv-2311-02848.title: Consistent4D: Consistent 360° Dynamic Object Generation from Monocular Video
arxiv-2311-02848.creator: Yanqin Jiang, Li Zhang, Jin Gao, Weimin Hu, Yao Yao
arxiv-2311-02848.description: Abstract In this paper, we present Consistent4D, a novel approach for generating 4D dynamic objects from uncalibrated monocular videos. Uniquely, we cast the 360-degree dynamic object reconstruction as a 4D generation problem, eliminating the need for tedious multi-view data collection and camera calibration.

arxiv-2412-08837.title: Modeling Mg ii resonance doublet spectra from galaxy haloes at z ∼ \sim 1
arxiv-2412-08837.creator: Seok-Jun Chang, Rajeshwari Dutta, Max Gronke, Michele Fumagalli, Fabrizio Arrigoni Battaia, Matteo Fossati
arxiv-2412-08837.description: Abstract We investigate the properties of cold gas at 10 4 ​ K 10^{4}~\rm K around star-forming galaxies at z ∼ 1 z~\sim~1 using Mg II spectra through radiative transfer modeling. We utilize a comprehensive dataset of 624 galaxies from the MAGG and MUDF programs.

arxiv-2412-13213.title: Montage and Radio Astronomy
arxiv-2412-13213.creator: G. Bruce Berriman, John C. Good, Ian Heywood, R. Moseley
arxiv-2412-13213.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by G. Bruce Berriman, John C. Good, Ian Heywood, R. Moseley. The Montage Image Mosaic Engine, first released in 2002, has found applicability across the electromagnetic spectrum to support data processing and visualization. This broad applicability has come about through its design as an Open Source ANSI-C toolkit (and Python binary extensions), with independent components to perform each step in the creation of a mosaic and with support for all WCS extensions.

arxiv-2412-14461.title: To Err Is Human; To Annotate, SILICON? Toward Robust Reproducibility in LLM Annotation
arxiv-2412-14461.creator: Xiang Cheng, Raveesh Mayya, João Sedoc, Updated: 2 April 2026. (For the Latest Version: Click Here )
arxiv-2412-14461.description: Abstract ABSTRACT Unstructured text data annotation is foundational to management research. LLMs offer a cost-effective and scalable alternative to human annotation, but they introduce a novel challenge: the annotator itself can be retired. Proprietary models undergo regular deprecation cycles, threatening long-term reproducibility. Hence, the ability to reproduce annotation results when the original model becomes unavailable, i.e.

arxiv-2501-12422.title: CroMe: Multimodal Fake News Detection using Cross-Modal Tri-Transformer and Metric Learning
arxiv-2501-12422.creator: EUNJEE CHOI, JUNHYUN AHN, XINYU PIAO, AND JONG-KOOK KIM
arxiv-2501-12422.description: Abstract Multimodal fake news detection has received increasing attention recently. Existing methods rely on independently encoded unimodal data and overlook the advantages of capturing intra-modal relationships and integrating inter-modal similarities using advanced techniques. To address these issues, Cross-Modal Tri-Transformer and Metric Learning (CroMe) for multimodal fake news detection is proposed.

arxiv-2505-10200.title: Analyzing atomic oxygen product evolution in Micro Cavity Plasma Arrays by a combination of a Multi-PMT OES Setup and a 0-D Chemical Model Journal: Plasma Sources Sci. Technol.
arxiv-2505-10200.creator: Henrik van Impel, David Steuer, Volker Schulz-von der Gathen, Marc Böke, Judith Golda
arxiv-2505-10200.description: Abstract Dielectric barrier discharges (DBDs) are widely used in applications such as ozone generation and volatile organic compound treatment, where performance can be enhanced through catalyst integration. A fundamental understanding of reactive species generation is essential for advancing these technologies.

arxiv-2509-17865.title: Addressing Model Inaccuracies in Transmission Network Reconfiguration via Diverse Alternatives
arxiv-2509-17865.creator: Paul Bannmüller 1 , Périne Cunat 1 7 , Ali Rajaei 1 , Jochen Cremer 1 7
arxiv-2509-17865.description: Abstract The ongoing energy transition places significant pressure on the transmission network due to increasing shares of renewables and electrification. To mitigate grid congestion, transmission system operators need decision support tools to suggest remedial actions, such as transmission network reconfigurations or redispatch.

arxiv-2510-20155.title: PartNeXt: A Next-Generation Dataset for Fine-Grained and Hierarchical 3D Part Understanding Thanks: Corresponding Author.
arxiv-2510-20155.creator: Penghao Wang Yiyang He Xin Lv Yukai Zhou
arxiv-2510-20155.description: Abstract Understanding objects at the level of their constituent parts is fundamental to advancing computer vision, graphics, and robotics. While datasets like PartNet have driven progress in 3D part understanding, their reliance on untextured geometries and expert-dependent annotation limits scalability and usability.

arxiv-2601-19990.title: Fully differential Higgs boson pair production at N 3 LO with top quark mass effects
arxiv-2601-19990.creator: Xuan Chen, Yuesheng Dai, Hai Tao Li, Shi-Yuan Li, Hua-Sheng Shao, and Jian Wang
arxiv-2601-19990.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xuan Chen, Yuesheng Dai, Hai Tao Li, Shi-Yuan Li, Hua-Sheng Shao, and Jian Wang. Higgs-boson pair production is of fundamental importance for probing the Higgs potential. At hadron colliders, the dominant production channel proceeds via gluon-gluon fusion (ggF) mediated by a top-quark loop. We report the first fully differential predictions for Higgs-boson pair production through ggF at next-to-next-to-next-to-leading order (N 3 LO) in the strong coupling α s \alpha_{s} in the heavy-top-quark limit (HTL).

arxiv-2602-06786.title: Machine Learning for Detection and Severity Estimation of Sweetpotato Weevil Damage in Field and Lab Conditions
arxiv-2602-06786.creator: Doreen M. Chelangat a , Sudi Murindanyi b , Bruce Mugizi c , Paul Musana a , Benard Yada a , Milton A. Otema a , Florence Osaru a , Andrew Katumba c , Joyce Nakatumba-Nabende b
arxiv-2602-06786.description: Abstract Sweetpotato weevils ( Cylas spp.) are considered among the most destructive pests impacting sweetpotato production, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. Traditional methods for assessing weevil damage, predominantly relying on manual scoring, are labour-intensive, subjective, and often yield inconsistent results. These challenges significantly hinder breeding programs aimed at developing resilient sweetpotato varieties.

arxiv-2602-19166.title: CosyAccent: Duration-Controllable Accent Normalization Using Source-Synthesis Training Data
arxiv-2602-19166.creator: Qibing Bai, Shuhao Shi, Shuai Wang, Yukai Ju, Yannan Wang, Haizhou Li
arxiv-2602-19166.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Qibing Bai, Shuhao Shi, Shuai Wang, Yukai Ju, Yannan Wang, Haizhou Li. Accent normalization (AN) systems often struggle with unnatural outputs and undesired content distortion, stemming from both suboptimal training data and rigid duration modeling. In this paper, we propose a ‘‘source-synthesis” methodology for training data construction. By generating source L2 speech and using authentic native speech as the training target, our approach avoids learning from TTS artifacts and, crucially, requires no real L2 data in training.

pmc-10532423.title: Structural and Thermomagnetic Properties of Gallium Nanoferrites and Their Influence on Cells In Vitro
pmc-10532423.creator: Marta Orzechowska, Katarzyna Rećko, Urszula Klekotka, Magdalena Czerniecka, Adam Tylicki, Dariusz Satuła, Dmytro V Soloviov, Anatoly I Beskrovnyy, Arkadiusz Miaskowski, Beata Kalska-Szostko, Daniel Arcos
pmc-10532423.description: Magnetite and gallium substituted cuboferrites with a composition of GaxFe3−xO4 (0 ≤ x ≤ 1.4) were fabricated by thermal decomposition from acetylacetonate salts. The effect of Ga3+ cation substitution on the structural and thermomagnetic behavior of 4–12 nm sized core-shell particles was explored by X-ray and neutron diffraction, small angle neutron scattering, transmission electron microscopy, Mössbauer spectroscopy, and calorimetric measurements.

pmc-10612275.title: Post-COVID-19 pulmonary complications among recovered COVID-19 patients: a cross-sectional study from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
pmc-10612275.creator: Abebaw Bekele Seyoum, Sisay Shine Tegegnework, Mahider Molla Mengistu, Tenbite Daniel Mekonnen, Abdurahman Mohammedamin Asabel, Alazar Gizate Dagnaw, Abenet Girma Deribe, Tadios Niguss Derese, Tsegaye Gebreyes Hundie, Bisrat Kassa Getahun, Dawit Kebede Huluka
pmc-10612275.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has been linked to chronic pulmonary complications all over the world. Respiratory complications such as chronic cough, dyspnea, increased respiratory rate, and oxygen support demand are prevalent in recovered COVID-19 patients. These problems are long-term and have a negative impact on one’s quality of life.

pmc-10618761.title: Real-world validation of Artificial Intelligence-based Computed Tomography auto-contouring for prostate cancer radiotherapy planning
pmc-10618761.creator: Gabriele Palazzo, Paola Mangili, Chiara Deantoni, Andrei Fodor, Sara Broggi, Roberta Castriconi, Maria Giulia Ubeira Gabellini, Antonella del Vecchio, Nadia G. Di Muzio, Claudio Fiorino
pmc-10618761.description: Highlights•Validation of commercial auto-contouring software for prostate cancer planning.•Variability of manual vs automatic contouring is lower than inter-observer variability.•Quick editing further improved performances, reducing inter-observer variability.•Contouring time was reduced from 17–24 min to 3–7 min.•An optimized and integrated automatic workflow was clinically implemented.

pmc-11355993.title: Birth of Thirty-Two Healthy Babies Following Transfer of Fresh and Frozen–Thawed Embryos Derived from Monopronuclear Zygotes: A Retrospective Study
pmc-11355993.creator: Soraya Labied, Frédéric Wenders, Olivier Gaspard, Stéphanie Ravet, Alice Desmecht, Michelle Nisolle, Laurie Henry
pmc-11355993.description: Background and Objectives: Fertilized zygotes normally display two pronuclei (PN), but abnormal fertilization patterns (0, 1 or >2PN) are observed daily in IVF labs. Multiple PN zygotes (>2) are generally discarded due to an increased risk of aneuploidy. However, the decision to transfer or not transfer 1PN-derived embryos remains controversial.

pmc-11405535.title: Decompositions of Hyperbolic Kac–Moody Algebras with Respect to Imaginary Root Groups
pmc-11405535.creator: Alex J. Feingold, Axel Kleinschmidt, Hermann Nicolai
pmc-11405535.description: We propose a novel way to define imaginary root subgroups associated with (timelike) imaginary roots of hyperbolic Kac–Moody algebras. Using in an essential way the theory of unitary irreducible representation of covers of the group SO(2, 1), these imaginary root subgroups act on the complex Kac–Moody algebra viewed as a Hilbert space.

pmc-11433758.title: Innovative Adsorbents for Pollutant Removal: Exploring the Latest Research and Applications
pmc-11433758.creator: Muhammad Saeed Akhtar, Sajid Ali, Wajid Zaman, Grégorio Crini
pmc-11433758.description: The growing presence of diverse pollutants, including heavy metals, organic compounds, pharmaceuticals, and emerging contaminants, poses significant environmental and health risks. Traditional methods for pollutant removal often face limitations in efficiency, selectivity, and sustainability. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of recent advancements in innovative adsorbents designed to address these challenges.

pmc-11658427.title: The association between vitamin D receptor gene polymorphism FokI and type 2 diabetic kidney disease and its molecular mechanism: a case control study
pmc-11658427.creator: Yaping Zhao, Zehui Liu, Shiyu Feng, Rong yang, Zhenqin Ran, Rong Zhu, Lijuan Ma, Zizhou Wang, Lixin Chen, Rui Han
pmc-11658427.description: BackgroundThe role of the vitamin D receptor single nucleotide polymorphism FOKI (VDR-FOKI) (rs2228570) in genetic susceptibility to type 2 diabetic kidney disease (T2DKD) remains uncertain. This study investigated the relationship between VDR-FOKI and T2DKD within the Chinese Plateau Han population and analyzed the underlying mechanisms.

pmc-12651218.title: Confirmatory Clinical Validation of a Serum-Based Biomarker Signature for Detection of Early-Stage Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
pmc-12651218.creator: Patricio M. Polanco, Tamas Gonda, Erkut Borazanci, Evan S. Glazer, Jose G. Trevino, George DeMuth, Lisa Ford, Thomas King, Norma A. Palma, Randall E. Brand
pmc-12651218.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) has one of the lowest 5-year survival rates of all malignancies, mainly because most cases are diagnosed at late stages. Diagnosing PDAC during early stages (Stage I and II) significantly improves patient survival. To aid in the early detection of PDAC, we developed and clinically validated a serum biomarker signature to distinguish early-stage PDAC in those at high risk of developing the disease.

pmc-12686711.title: Fostamatinib (R788), a spleen tyrosine kinase inhibitor, sensitizes pancreatic cancer cells to oncolytic vesicular stomatitis virus
pmc-12686711.creator: Cassandra Catacalos-Goad, Dakota W. Goad, Molly C. Holbrook, Quinton Krueger, Isha M. Wilson, M. Abdul Hajjar, Valery Z. Grdzelishvili
pmc-12686711.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is one of the most lethal malignancies with limited treatment options. Oncolytic virus (OV) therapy exploits replication-competent viruses, including vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV), to preferentially infect and kill malignant cells, while sparing non-malignant cells. We previously showed that human PDAC cell lines are highly heterogeneous in their permissiveness to VSV and other OVs.

pmc-12693199.title: Experimental Study of the Discharging Process of Sorption Heat Storage Units Filled with 13X Zeolite
pmc-12693199.creator: Beata Pytlik, Daniel Smykowski, Piotr Szulc, Tomasz Tietze, Beata Anwajler, Artur Chorążyczewski
pmc-12693199.description: The paper presents the experimental study of the zeolite heat storage unit discharging process in a laboratory scale. The Authors focused on the discharging process, which utilizes adsorption of water, in the form of steam, on zeolite, because the adsorption process is considered as more challenging in terms of reaction kinetics and heat transfer.

pmc-12965256.title: Milk Production, Composition, and Reproductive Performance of Crossbred Dairy Stock on Smallholder Dairying in Ethiopia
pmc-12965256.creator: Adinow Abate, Habtamu Lemma Didanna, Asrat Ayza
pmc-12965256.description: Regular evaluation of dairy stock performance under current management practices is essential for the success of dairy production and crossbreeding programs. However, the lack of up-to-date, comprehensive, and location-specific information hinders the implementation of effective intervention strategies to enhance dairy productivity in the tropics.

pmc-13177768.title: Public informed training: Developing a curriculum for trialists using health systems data
pmc-13177768.creator: Fiona Lugg-Widger, Rob Trubey, Mike Robling, Marion Mafham, Matthew Sydes, Victoria Shepherd, Rebecca Cannings-John, Kerenza Hood, Nagheen Ahmed, Sadman Islam, Sarah Rawlinson
pmc-13177768.description: portunities to address them through the development of training resources. Objective and Approach We present a programme of work to identify, facilitate and optimise emerging practices for using health systems data in trials, informed by subject matter experts and steered by public input, to begin addressing the ongoing challenges for trial teams.

pmc-13300311.title: Notch Timing (NT): A novel criterion to predict the site of origin in Outflow Tract PVCs
pmc-13300311.creator: A Jaouadi, O Ekrem Turan, Y Yilancioglu, E Evren Ozcan
pmc-13300311.description: BackgroundThe Outflow Tracts (OT) represent a critical site of arrhythmogenesis for idiopathic premature ventricular contractions (PVCs). Accurately predicting the PVC's site of origin (SOO) for ablation is hindered by the region's intricate and highly variable anatomy. This has led to the development of numerous ECG algorithms, which, unfortunately, are plagued by a trade-off between diagnostic accuracy and clinical practicality.

uslaw-usc-t20-s121.title: 20 U.S.C. § 121 — Annual report of president and directors
uslaw-usc-t20-s121.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s121.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 8 (Howard University); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The president and directors of Howard University shall report to the Secretary of Education the condition of the institution on the 1st of July of each year, embracing therein the number of pupils received and discharged or leaving the same for any cause.
